s:
Consider the following statements:
I. Nagarjunasagar–Srisailam is a Tiger Reserve.
II. Koundinya Sanctuary & Royal Elephant Reserve is an Elephant Reserve.
III. Seshachalam is a Biosphere Reserve.
IV. Indira Gandhi Zoological Park is located in Tirupathi.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

x: Both are true: Pulicat Lake sanctuary lies on the Tirupati–Tamil Nadu border, and Rollapadu protects the Great Indian Bustard and lesser florican.
Two are zoological parks: Indira Gandhi (Visakhapatnam) and Sri Venkateswara (Tirupati). The Dolphin Conservation Society is an ex-situ biodiversity park and Seshachalam a biosphere reserve.
